verdict.rationale: Figma ships an official, well-documented MCP server (local and remote) that lets AI clients read/write Figma content, extract design context, generate code, and more, with detailed docs on installation, tools, and custom rules (figma-docs-1/3/5/38/59/67/68/69, figma-probe-3). This is a first-party, actively maintained integration point for agentic MCP clients. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification that the MCP connection works reliably in practice (community evidence only discusses unrelated Figma pain points, not MCP specifically).
